# Auto-Generated File Templates

This document shows examples of files that Vivado/Vitis automatically generates.

**NOTE:** These are examples only - actual values depend on your Vivado design!

---

## 1. `xparameters.h` (Generated by Vivado)

**Location:** `vitis_workspace/platform_project/ps7_cortexa9_0/standalone_domain/bsp/ps7_cortexa9_0/include/xparameters.h`

**Generated when:** You export hardware from Vivado to Vitis

```c
/******************************************************************************
*
* AUTO-GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY
*
* This file is automatically generated by Vivado when exporting hardware
*
******************************************************************************/

#ifndef XPARAMETERS_H
#define XPARAMETERS_H

/**************************************************************************/
/***************************** Include Files ******************************/
/**************************************************************************/

#include "xparameters_ps.h"

/**************************************************************************/
/************************** Constant Definitions **************************/
/**************************************************************************/

/*
 * Define for debug prints
 */
#define DEBUG_MODE

/**************************************************************************/
/**                      Device ID Definitions                          **/
/**************************************************************************/

#define XPAR_XSPI_ACCEL_NUM_INSTANCES 1
#define XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_DEVICE_ID 0

#define XPAR_XTMRCTR_NUM_INSTANCES 1
#define XPAR_TMRCTR_0_DEVICE_ID 0

#define XPAR_XSCUGIC_NUM_INSTANCES 1
#define XPAR_SCUGIC_SINGLE_DEVICE_ID 0
#define XPAR_SCUGIC_0_DEVICE_ID 0

/**************************************************************************/
/**              Peripheral Base Address Definitions                    **/
/**************************************************************************/

/*
 * Definitions for driver SPI_ACCEL
 */
#define XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR 0x43C00000
#define XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_HIGHADDR 0x43C0FFFF

/*
 * Definitions for driver TMRCTR (AXI Timer)
 */
#define XPAR_TMRCTR_0_BASEADDR 0x42800000
#define XPAR_TMRCTR_0_HIGHADDR 0x4280FFFF
#define XPAR_TMRCTR_0_CLOCK_FREQ_HZ 100000000

/*
 * Definitions for driver SCUGIC (Generic Interrupt Controller)
 */
#define XPAR_SCUGIC_0_CPU_BASEADDR 0xF8F00100
#define XPAR_SCUGIC_0_DIST_BASEADDR 0xF8F01000

/**************************************************************************/
/**                   Interrupt Vector ID Definitions                   **/
/**************************************************************************/

/*
 * Interrupt IDs (IRQ numbers)
 */
#define XPAR_FABRIC_TMRCTR_0_VEC_ID 61U  /* Timer interrupt to GIC */

/**************************************************************************/
/**              Canonical Definitions (Legacy Support)                 **/
/**************************************************************************/

/*
 * Canonical definitions for driver SPI_ACCEL
 */
#define XPAR_XSPI_ACCEL_0_DEVICE_ID XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_DEVICE_ID
#define XPAR_XSPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR 0x43C00000
#define XPAR_XSPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_HIGHADDR 0x43C0FFFF

/*
 * Canonical definitions for driver TMRCTR
 */
#define XPAR_TMRCTR_0_DEVICE_ID XPAR_TMRCTR_0_DEVICE_ID
#define XPAR_TMRCTR_0_BASEADDR 0x42800000
#define XPAR_TMRCTR_0_HIGHADDR 0x4280FFFF

#endif /* XPARAMETERS_H */
```

**Key Points:**
- Base addresses are assigned by Vivado based on your address map
- Device IDs start from 0 for each IP type
- Instance names (`SPI_ACCEL_0`) come from your block design
- **This file should NEVER be edited manually** - regenerate by re-exporting hardware

## 2. `xspi_accel_hw.h` (Generated During IP Packaging)

**Location:** `IP_Repo/spi_accel_1.0/drivers/spi_accel_v1_0/src/xspi_accel_hw.h`

**Generated when:** You package the IP in Vivado (optional step)

```c
/******************************************************************************
*
* AUTO-GENERATED FILE - Register definitions
*
******************************************************************************/

#ifndef XSPI_ACCEL_HW_H_
#define XSPI_ACCEL_HW_H_

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/***************************** Include Files *********************************/

#include "xil_types.h"
#include "xil_io.h"

/************************** Constant Definitions *****************************/

/*
 * Register Map for spi_accel AXI-Lite Interface S00_AXI
 */
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG0_OFFSET 0   // CONTROL_REG
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG1_OFFSET 4   // TX_COUNT_REG
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG2_OFFSET 8   // TX_DATA_REG
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG3_OFFSET 12  // STATUS_REG
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG4_OFFSET 16  // RX_COUNT_REG
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG5_OFFSET 20  // RX_DATA_REG

/*
 * Address range (from IP parameters)
 */
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_ADDR_WIDTH    6
#define SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_DATA_WIDTH    32

/**************************** Type Definitions *******************************/

/**************************** Macro Definitions ******************************/

/**
 * Write a value to a SPI_ACCEL register. A 32 bit write is performed.
 *
 * @param   BaseAddress is the base address of the SPI_ACCEL device.
 * @param   RegOffset is the register offset from the base to write to.
 * @param   Data is the data written to the register.
 *
 * @return  None.
 *
 * @note    C-style signature:
 *          void SPI_ACCEL_mWriteReg(u32 BaseAddress, unsigned RegOffset, u32 Data)
 *
 */
#define SPI_ACCEL_mWriteReg(BaseAddress, RegOffset, Data) \
    Xil_Out32((BaseAddress) + (RegOffset), (u32)(Data))

/**
 * Read a value from a SPI_ACCEL register. A 32 bit read is performed.
 *
 * @param   BaseAddress is the base address of the SPI_ACCEL device.
 * @param   RegOffset is the register offset from the base to read from.
 *
 * @return  Data read from the register.
 *
 * @note    C-style signature:
 *          u32 SPI_ACCEL_mReadReg(u32 BaseAddress, unsigned RegOffset)
 *
 */
#define SPI_ACCEL_mReadReg(BaseAddress, RegOffset) \
    Xil_In32((BaseAddress) + (RegOffset))

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* XSPI_ACCEL_HW_H_ */
```

**Usage Example:**
```c
#include "xspi_accel_hw.h"
#include "xparameters.h"

// Write to control register
SPI_ACCEL_mWriteReg(XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR,
                    SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG0_OFFSET,
                    0x00000019);  // Mode 3, scale=25

// Read status register
u32 status = SPI_ACCEL_mReadReg(XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR,
                                 SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG3_OFFSET);
```

## 3. `xspi_accel.h` (Generated During IP Packaging)

**Location:** `IP_Repo/spi_accel_1.0/drivers/spi_accel_v1_0/src/xspi_accel.h`

**Generated when:** You package the IP in Vivado (optional step)

```c
/******************************************************************************
*
* AUTO-GENERATED FILE - Driver interface
*
******************************************************************************/

#ifndef XSPI_ACCEL_H_
#define XSPI_ACCEL_H_

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/***************************** Include Files *********************************/

#include "xil_types.h"
#include "xstatus.h"
#include "xspi_accel_hw.h"

/************************** Constant Definitions *****************************/

/**************************** Type Definitions *******************************/

/**
 * This typedef contains configuration information for the device.
 */
typedef struct {
    u16 DeviceId;           /* Unique ID of device */
    u32 S00_Axi_Baseaddr;   /* Base address of AXI-Lite interface */
} XSpi_Accel_Config;

/**
 * The XSpi_Accel driver instance data. The user is required to allocate a
 * variable of this type for every spi_accel device in the system. A pointer
 * to a variable of this type is then passed to the driver API functions.
 */
typedef struct {
    u32 BaseAddress;    /* Device base address */
    u32 IsReady;        /* Device is initialized and ready */
} XSpi_Accel;

/***************** Macros (Inline Functions) Definitions *********************/

/**
 * Get the base address of the SPI_ACCEL instance
 */
#define XSpi_Accel_GetBaseAddr(InstancePtr) \
    ((InstancePtr)->BaseAddress)

/**
 * Check if the device is ready
 */
#define XSpi_Accel_IsReady(InstancePtr) \
    ((InstancePtr)->IsReady == XIL_COMPONENT_IS_READY)

/************************** Function Prototypes ******************************/

/**
 * Lookup the device configuration based on the unique device ID.
 *
 * @param   DeviceId is the unique device ID to search for.
 *
 * @return  A pointer to the configuration structure or NULL if not found.
 */
XSpi_Accel_Config* XSpi_Accel_LookupConfig(u16 DeviceId);

/**
 * Initialize the SPI_ACCEL instance.
 *
 * @param   InstancePtr is a pointer to the XSpi_Accel instance.
 * @param   Config is a pointer to the configuration structure.
 *
 * @return  XST_SUCCESS if successful, otherwise XST_FAILURE.
 */
int XSpi_Accel_CfgInitialize(XSpi_Accel *InstancePtr, XSpi_Accel_Config *Config);

/**
 * Write a 32-bit value to a register
 */
void XSpi_Accel_WriteReg(u32 BaseAddress, unsigned RegOffset, u32 Data);

/**
 * Read a 32-bit value from a register
 */
u32 XSpi_Accel_ReadReg(u32 BaseAddress, unsigned RegOffset);

/*
 * Selftest function (optional)
 */
int XSpi_Accel_SelfTest(XSpi_Accel *InstancePtr);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* XSPI_ACCEL_H_ */
```

## 4. `xspi_accel.c` (Generated During IP Packaging)

**Location:** `IP_Repo/spi_accel_1.0/drivers/spi_accel_v1_0/src/xspi_accel.c`

```c
/******************************************************************************
*
* AUTO-GENERATED FILE - Driver implementation
*
******************************************************************************/

/***************************** Include Files *********************************/

#include "xspi_accel.h"
#include "xil_io.h"

/************************** Constant Definitions *****************************/

/**************************** Type Definitions *******************************/

/***************** Macros (Inline Functions) Definitions *********************/

/************************** Variable Definitions *****************************/

/*
 * Config table - one entry per instance in the system
 * Auto-generated based on number of instances in hardware
 */
XSpi_Accel_Config XSpi_Accel_ConfigTable[] =
{
    {
        XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_DEVICE_ID,
        XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR
    }
};

/************************** Function Definitions *****************************/

/**
 * Lookup configuration based on device ID
 */
XSpi_Accel_Config* XSpi_Accel_LookupConfig(u16 DeviceId)
{
    XSpi_Accel_Config *CfgPtr = NULL;
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < XPAR_XSPI_ACCEL_NUM_INSTANCES; i++) {
        if (XSpi_Accel_ConfigTable[i].DeviceId == DeviceId) {
            CfgPtr = &XSpi_Accel_ConfigTable[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    return CfgPtr;
}

/**
 * Initialize the driver instance
 */
int XSpi_Accel_CfgInitialize(XSpi_Accel *InstancePtr, XSpi_Accel_Config *Config)
{
    /* Verify arguments */
    Xil_AssertNonvoid(InstancePtr != NULL);
    Xil_AssertNonvoid(Config != NULL);

    /* Clear instance memory */
    memset(InstancePtr, 0, sizeof(XSpi_Accel));

    /* Set base address */
    InstancePtr->BaseAddress = Config->S00_Axi_Baseaddr;

    /* Set ready flag */
    InstancePtr->IsReady = XIL_COMPONENT_IS_READY;

    return XST_SUCCESS;
}

/**
 * Write to register
 */
void XSpi_Accel_WriteReg(u32 BaseAddress, unsigned RegOffset, u32 Data)
{
    Xil_Out32(BaseAddress + RegOffset, Data);
}

/**
 * Read from register
 */
u32 XSpi_Accel_ReadReg(u32 BaseAddress, unsigned RegOffset)
{
    return Xil_In32(BaseAddress + RegOffset);
}

/**
 * Self-test function (verifies base address is accessible)
 */
int XSpi_Accel_SelfTest(XSpi_Accel *InstancePtr)
{
    u32 baseaddr;
    u32 read_data;

    Xil_AssertNonvoid(InstancePtr != NULL);
    Xil_AssertNonvoid(InstancePtr->IsReady == XIL_COMPONENT_IS_READY);

    baseaddr = InstancePtr->BaseAddress;

    /* Try to read from control register */
    read_data = XSpi_Accel_mReadReg(baseaddr, SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG0_OFFSET);

    /* Write a test pattern */
    XSpi_Accel_mWriteReg(baseaddr, SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG0_OFFSET, 0xAAAAAAAA);

    /* Read back */
    read_data = XSpi_Accel_mReadReg(baseaddr, SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG0_OFFSET);

    /* Check if write succeeded (considering writable bits only) */
    if ((read_data & 0x001FFFFF) != 0x000AAAAA) {
        return XST_FAILURE;
    }

    return XST_SUCCESS;
}
```

**Generated when:** You create an application in Vitis

```ld

_HEAP_SIZE = DEFINED(_HEAP_SIZE) ? _HEAP_SIZE : 0x2000;

/* Memory layout */
MEMORY
{

   ps7_ram_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR : ORIGIN = 0xFFFF0000, LENGTH = 0xFE00
   ps7_ram_1_S_AXI_BASEADDR : ORIGIN = 0xFFFF0000, LENGTH = 0x10000
}

/* Sections */
SECTIONS
{
.text : {
   KEEP (*(.vectors))
   *(.boot)
   *(.text)
   *(.text.*)
   *(.gnu.linkonce.t.*)
   *(.plt)
   *(.gnu_warning)
   *(.gcc_except_table)
   *(.glue_7)
   *(.glue_7t)
   *(.vfp11_veneer)
   *(.ARM.extab)
   *(.gnu.linkonce.armextab.*)
} > ps7_ddr_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR

.init : {
   KEEP (*(.init))
} > ps7_ddr_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR

.fini : {
   KEEP (*(.fini))
} > ps7_ddr_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR

.rodata : {
   __rodata_start = .;
   *(.rodata)
   *(.rodata.*)
   *(.gnu.linkonce.r.*)
   __rodata_end = .;
} > ps7_ddr_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR

.data : {
   __data_start = .;
   *(.data)
   *(.data.*)
   *(.gnu.linkonce.d.*)
   __data_end = .;
} > ps7_ddr_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR

.bss (NOLOAD) : {
   __bss_start__ = .;
   *(.bss)
   *(.bss.*)
   *(.gnu.linkonce.b.*)
   *(COMMON)
   __bss_end__ = .;
} > ps7_ddr_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR

.heap (NOLOAD) : {
   . = ALIGN(8);
   _heap = .;
   _heap_start = .;

.stack (NOLOAD) : {

   _stack = .;

} > ps7_ddr_0_S_AXI_BASEADDR

_end = .;
```

## Usage Example: How They All Work Together

### In Your Application Code

```c
/******************************************************************************
 * main.c - Your application using ALL the layers
 ******************************************************************************/

// Layer 0: BSP auto-generated headers
#include "xparameters.h"      // ← Auto-generated by Vivado
#include "xil_printf.h"       // ← BSP
#include "xil_io.h"           // ← BSP
#include "xscugic.h"          // ← BSP (GIC driver)
#include "xtmrctr.h"          // ← BSP (Timer driver)

// Layer 1: IP driver (optional - if you created it)
#include "xspi_accel.h"       // ← Auto-generated during IP packaging
#include "xspi_accel_hw.h"    // ← Auto-generated during IP packaging

// Layer 2: Your custom driver
#include "spi_accel.h"        // ← Your custom ADXL345 driver

// Layer 3: Application
int main(void)
{
    // Option 1: Use auto-generated low-level macros
    #ifdef USE_LOW_LEVEL
    SPI_ACCEL_mWriteReg(XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR,
                        SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG0_OFFSET,
                        0x19);
    #endif

    // Option 2: Use auto-generated driver (if created)
    #ifdef USE_AUTO_DRIVER
    XSpi_Accel spi_inst;
    XSpi_Accel_Config *cfg;

    cfg = XSpi_Accel_LookupConfig(XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_DEVICE_ID);
    XSpi_Accel_CfgInitialize(&spi_inst, cfg);
    XSpi_Accel_WriteReg(spi_inst.BaseAddress, SPI_ACCEL_S00_AXI_SLV_REG0_OFFSET, 0x19);
    #endif

    // Option 3: Use your custom driver (RECOMMENDED)
    SPI_Init(XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR);
    ADXL345_Init(XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR);

    AccelData data;
    ADXL345_ReadAccel(XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR, &data);

    return 0;
}
```

## Summary: File Generation Flow

```
1. Vivado: Create IP
   ├─→ Create HDL files (you write)
   ├─→ Package IP
   └─→ Optionally generate driver templates
       ├─→ xspi_accel.h
       ├─→ xspi_accel.c
       ├─→ xspi_accel_hw.h
       └─→ spi_accel.mdd

2. Vivado: Block Design
   ├─→ Add IP instance (name it: spi_accel_0)
   ├─→ Assign base address (e.g., 0x43C00000)
   └─→ Export hardware (.xsa file)

3. Vitis: Create Platform
   ├─→ Import .xsa file
   └─→ Generate BSP
       ├─→ xparameters.h        ← Contains XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR
       ├─→ xparameters_ps.h
       ├─→ xscugic.h
       ├─→ xtmrctr.h
       └─→ [other BSP files]

4. Vitis: Create Application
   ├─→ Add your source files
   │   ├─→ main.c
   │   ├─→ spi_accel.h
   │   └─→ spi_accel.c
   └─→ Build
       └─→ Generates .elf executable
```

## Critical Dependency Chain

```
Vivado Instance Name
    ↓
"spi_accel_0"
    ↓
Export Hardware
    ↓
xparameters.h generated with:
    #define XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR 0x43C00000
    ↓
Your code uses:
    #define SPI_ACCEL_BASEADDR XPAR_SPI_ACCEL_0_S00_AXI_BASEADDR
    ↓
Driver function call:
    ADXL345_Init(SPI_ACCEL_BASEADDR);
    ↓
Expands to:
    ADXL345_Init(0x43C00000);
```

**If any link in this chain breaks, your code won't compile or won't work!**
